changelog: - **Every stage write into `TRIAL_ACTIVE` now stamps the trial window, so the trial reminders and the expiry sweep work on real records** (#2551, story #2392). Before this no production path wrote `trialStartedAt`/`trialEndsAt` — only the demo seeder did — so the reminder ladder, the auto-move to `TRIAL_EXPIRED` and the attention queue skipped every real trial. New pure `trialWindowFor({ toStage, enteredAt, existing, lengthDays })` in `src/lib/trialReminderRule.ts` returns dates only for a move into `TRIAL_ACTIVE` with no trial end yet and never overwrites one (a re-entry keeps the first window; a start without an end gets only the end); `TRIAL_ACTIVE_STAGE_KEY` moves into that dependency-free module and is re-exported from `programTemplates.ts`. New org setting `trialLengthDays` (default 30, 1..365, invalid falls back to 30 rather than stamping trials that are over on arrival), on `/admin/settings` for MARKETING tenants only. `src/lib/trialWindow.ts` (`stageTrialWindow`) resolves the setting and is spread into the SAME `data` block that moves the stage in the board/record `PUT /api/mentorship/[id]`, `POST /api/status-changes` (live moves only), the admin bulk advance, the four start-stage creates (`POST /api/mentorship`, mentor-added mentees, invitation auto-link, re-match approval) and — through new pure builders `funnelRelationCreateData`/`funnelRelationUpdateData` in `marketingImport.ts` — the marketing import's create and update (a re-run that does not move the record is not an entry). Not in `emitStageChange()`: it runs after the write and the import never calls it. The mentor transfer copies the window verbatim via `CARRIED_OVER_FIELDS`/`carriedOverFields()` in `relationHistory.ts` (`docs/mentor-transfer.md` updated). New ratchet `scripts/test/trial-window-writers.test.mjs` fails on any `src/` file that writes `pipelineStatus` without a stamper or a reasoned EXEMPT entry, and on stale exemptions; unit tests for the rule, the import builders and the transfer copy; `e2e/trial-window-stamp.spec.ts` pins board move → `trialEndsAt = entry + 30d`, re-entry keeps the first window, and the seven-day reminder is selected on day 23. No schema change.

en: Moving an account into "Trial running" now sets its trial dates automatically — by default a 30-day trial, adjustable under Settings — so the trial reminders and the automatic move to "Trial expired" work for every account. A trial that leaves the stage and comes back keeps its original end date.
tr: Bir hesabı "Deneme sürüyor" aşamasına taşımak artık deneme tarihlerini otomatik olarak belirliyor — varsayılan 30 gün, Ayarlar'dan değiştirilebilir — böylece deneme hatırlatmaları ve "Deneme süresi doldu" aşamasına otomatik geçiş her hesap için çalışıyor. Aşamadan çıkıp geri dönen bir deneme ilk bitiş tarihini koruyor.
de: Wird ein Account nach "Testphase läuft" verschoben, werden die Testdaten jetzt automatisch gesetzt — standardmäßig 30 Tage, in den Einstellungen anpassbar —, sodass die Testphasen-Erinnerungen und der automatische Wechsel nach "Testphase abgelaufen" für jeden Account funktionieren. Eine Testphase, die die Phase verlässt und zurückkehrt, behält ihr ursprüngliches Enddatum.
